reasoning_content:
The fix removes the `await asyncio.sleep(0)` between the read and write of `self.value`. Since `asyncio.sleep(WORK_DELAY_SECONDS)` still yields control, the work remains concurrent (all 50 tasks sleep simultaneously). The increment is now atomic — no await between load and store, so no task can be preempted mid-read-modify-write.

Now run the tests.
